correctness.rationale: The exact absolute-value semiconjugacy, maximal three consecutive outer visits from P^3(t)=rho<1, four-block derivative bound, strict period-eight word, and invariant-measure rigidity are all established analytically. At equality the count-one four-window property forces four-periodic symbolism; the fourth return g^4(u)=rho-ts^3u expands away from a unique fixed point. The signed lift is one primitive eight-cycle. The included rational arithmetic checker passed representative computations but is not used to prove the universal statements.
